 ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioner has filed this petition seeking a direction to the respondent No.3 & 4 to award the compensation of Rs.43,39,150/-.
Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that a land of the petitioner has been utilized for consideration of canal which was being considered by the department of Water Resources.

It is contended by the counsel that the petitioner submitted an application for compensation as well but the same was not awarded to the petitioner and having found no other alternate remedy, the petitioner has filed the present petition seeking compensation.

It is contended by the counsel for the respondents No.4 & 5 that an award was already passed on 31/07/2017 by the Sub Divisional Officer cum Land Acquisition Officer, Bansagar Project, Tehsil Tyonthar Jawa, Rewa.

The petitioner while filing this petition in the month of March, 2018 did not disclose that the award had already been passed by the Sub Divisional Officer on 31/07/2017.Learned counsel for the petitioner does not dispute that an award was passed on 31/07/2017.

Accordingly, the present petition stands disposed of while extending liberty to the petitioner to take recourse to appropriate proceedings if he is aggrieved by the award dated 31/07/2017 passed by the SDO in terms of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
